# Retired `verify.yml` matrix entries: inputs absent from `main` (2026-10-29)

At [`2b635c9`](https://github.com/lalalune/pumpfun-source/commit/2b635c9a64fe177b29561144b54f3f5bea87cef8), `.github/workflows/verify.yml` ran 77 matrix suites
(374 commands plus 5 comment lines), and none of them passed. 357 commands run, read or only prepare for files that
are not in the tree. This change retires those commands and keeps every other command, including two that still fail for
unrelated reasons. No evidence, verifier, test, program source or other workflow is changed. Retired suites are
recorded here, not reported as passing or silently skipped.

Mechanism: merge [`fce9f28`](https://github.com/lalalune/pumpfun-source/commit/fce9f28dd1cc3257d65b3c20afe60acfa8955545) ("update and cleanup") removed the
`research/`, `repro/` and `audit/` trees. Its second parent [`d75184e`](https://github.com/lalalune/pumpfun-source/tree/d75184ea323be8a83ebe11fe5f26a13f3dcbe052)
still has them, and the workflow kept the commands that use them. This says nothing about whether the original
contributions were correct.

Every path cited below is absent at `2b635c9` and present at `d75184e` (288/288, checked with `git cat-file -e`).
A row lists the paths each retired command names that are absent, plus the first absent file its script read when run.
Restoring a suite therefore needs at least these files, and possibly more that the restored scripts read. Re-add its
commands from `verify.yml` at `2b635c9`.

## Kept

- `composition-patch-bytes`: 2 commands.
- `evidence`: 10 commands; 31 retired.
- `host-fragments`: 5 commands; 4 retired.
- In `evidence`, `scripts/test_reconstruction_build_selection.py` runs two of its three tests. The third,
  `test_current_helper_matches_accepted_historical_helper`, compares `scripts/build_partial_candidate.py` with the absent
  `repro/pump_fees/sharing-pump-extend-main-v144/helpers/scripts/build_partial_candidate.py`. A test added to that file later
  must also be added to the command.
- In `host-fragments`, `tests/test_recovered_curve_arithmetic.py` still compiles and checks the constant-product and
  sell-accounting hosts. Their separate compile steps fed only the retired validators. The validators read absent
  `research/imported-lab/analysis/pump_fun/curve-fresh-trades-v3-signed-surfpool.json`; the sell-accounting validator
  also reads absent `repro/pump/constant-product-differential.json`.

## Retired

357 commands: every command of 74 suites, plus 31 from `evidence`, 4 from `host-fragments`.
Steps listed without a path only built, prepared or consumed files for retired steps in the same suite. The exception is
`git diff --exit-code -- audit/local-validation.json` in `evidence`: it exits 0 only because `audit/` is no longer
tracked, so it compares nothing.

The current-checkpoint verifiers (`scripts/verify_current_checkpoint.py`, `scripts/pump_replay_main_checkpoint.py`,
`scripts/verify_pump_amm_checkpoint.py`, `scripts/verify_current_bindings.py`) all read absent `repro/status.json`.
Restoring that ledger and the files it names would be the first step to bring checkpoint verification back to CI.
